title: Spencer's portfolio · image concepts
question: Three soft charcoal/red directions. Choose one, combine details, or steer another round. These are static proposals; mouse response comes in implementation.

options.label: A · Sculpture studio
options.thesis: A professional introduction with one tactile 3D focal point.
options.viewport: Introduction left, interactive sculpture right, selected work immediately beneath.
options.risk: The sculpture must stay subordinate to real work.

raised.raise: All destinations are explicit and navigation stays familiar.
Every graphic carries an intentional geometry.
The palette and typography stay consistent throughout.
Content proportions govern the full page.
Pointer-responsive depth returns to a quiet rest.

options.label: B · Project gallery
options.thesis: The work itself becomes the opening visual.
options.viewport: Large project previews share the first viewport with the introduction; experience follows.
options.risk: A familiar portfolio structure needs strong real project imagery.

options.label: C · Interactive field
options.thesis: A responsive red surface brings depth behind a stable professional layout.
options.viewport: Clear introduction left, a deforming field right, work beneath.
options.case: Expressive and responsive, but less direct than Sculpture studio.
options.risk: GPU cost and distraction need a fallback and strict bounds.

options.label: Teletext service
options.thesis: A reference system evaluated for this portfolio.
options.viewport: Professional content translated into the reference system.
options.case: Weaker professional identification and clarity than the main concepts.
options.risk: Retro page grammar interrupts professional reading.
